facts.fact: Lynn Canyon is a public park with a suspension bridge, forest trails and boardwalks; the bridge is about 50 metres above Lynn Creek.
facts.location: Opening Lynn Canyon Suspension Bridge description.

facts.fact: The Ecology Centre offers interpretation of temperate rainforest plants, animals and environmental issues. The tourism association recommends public transport or cycling to reduce parking pressure.
facts.location: Lynn Canyon Ecology Centre and Tips sections.

notes: Read tourism association article. The dated 2025 renovation notice is historical and is NOT treated as a current closure. The guide requires checking current District notices and avoids promising unrestricted access. Cliff-jumping advice is independently supported by the District safety notice.
